name: Erythropoietin (EPO)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Erythropoietin (EPO) is a recombinant protein supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 3000 iu. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Erythropoietin (EPO) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Erythropoietin (EPO) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the EPO certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (no public CAS entry).

faq.question: How should Erythropoietin (EPO) be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for Erythropoietin (EPO): store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the EPO lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Erythropoietin (EPO)?
faq.answer: Erythropoietin (EPO) is stocked in 1 pack size (3000 IU), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $64.06; 10–49 kits falls to $58.94 (−8%) and 50+ to $54.46 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
